Requirement*: System SHALL render filter fields in one of three states based on the caller's access tier: (1) Active — Tier 1, selectable. Acceptance criteria*: All three render states visible in ELITE and ADKP filter panels. Locked fields display lock icon and correct tier label. 'Request access' CTA links to Synapse access request workflow.
Notes: SciData does not need this specific solution; but we do need to define requirements to fulfill the PCO framework for privacy and security.

Notes: SciData does not need this specific solution; but we do need a smooth user flow from cohort identification -> request access to data
